name: BARE Basics
description: Common BARE code templates and patterns

snippets.name: Print
snippets.description: Print a value or concatenated string

snippets.name: Input
snippets.description: Read a line of input from the user

snippets.name: If/Else
snippets.description: Conditional statement (nest additional ifs inside else for elseif behavior)

snippets.name: Nested If (elseif style)
snippets.description: BARE has no elseif; nest an if inside else to chain conditions
snippets.content:
if guess < secret
    print "Too low!"
else
    if guess > secret
        print "Too high!"
    else
        print "Correct!"
    end
end

snippets.name: While Loop
snippets.description: The only loop construct in BARE
snippets.content:
i = 0
while i < 5
    print i
    i = i + 1
end

snippets.name: Sub (Function)
snippets.description: Define a reusable block of code with parameters and a return value

snippets.name: Recursive Sub
snippets.content:
sub factorial(n)
    if n <= 1
        return 1
    else
        return n * factorial(n - 1)
    end
end

snippets.name: List Create/Access
snippets.description: Create a list, index it, and mutate an element

snippets.name: Append to List
snippets.description: Grow a list and get its length

snippets.name: String Concatenation
snippets.description: Concatenate strings and numbers with + (numbers auto-convert)

snippets.name: Reverse a String
snippets.description: Build a new string by walking an index backwards
snippets.content:
sub reverse(word)
    result = ""
    i = len(word) - 1
    while i >= 0
        result = result + word[i]
        i = i - 1
    end
    return result
end

snippets.name: Code Timer
snippets.description: A simple code timer to measure the execution time of a block of code.
snippets.content:
start = time()
finish = time()
ex_time = round((finish-start),0)
if ex_time == 0
    print "Code execution took less then a second."
else
    print "Code execution took " + ex_time + " seconds."
end
